I told Dana in her DM that Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for 185 seats.

That number comes from her own posts in #north-team on Aug 20, 2025. She first wrote 180, then corrected it a few minutes later: "It's 185, not 180."

The amendment itself isn't in the files I can read, so I couldn't check it against the signed copy. I suggested she ask June Osei-Lark, who has the signed copy, if she wants to confirm it.
